products.description: A mini skirt with a point of difference – the Brey Leather design is defined by its light and lively balloon silhouette. Getting better with time, the supple leather skirt closes with a zip and hook closure.

products.name: Palomie Suede maxi skirt
products.description: An ankle-gracing design that will only get better with time – such is the Palomie Suede skirt. Inspired by classic tailoring, the straight, fitted silhouette has a side slit and a discreet zip closure. Wear with a casual T-shirt or a tailored shirt depending on the occasion – and your mood.

products.name: Boshan midi skirt
products.description: A tried-and-tested wardrobe staple, the Boshan skirt sways gently as you move. Crafted from an effortless fabrication, the A-line design comes with a hidden elastic waistband and midi length. Pair with the long sleeved Fayeh T-shirt to add contrast.

products.name: Erika maxi skirt
products.description: Add a romantic appeal to your spring and summer wardrobe, courtesy of the Erika maxi skirt – which stands out with its luxe satin and vintage-inspired lace trims. Dress down for everyday with a minimalistic T-shirt or wear with the matching Madeleine top for the season’s soirees.
